content.content: An exclude-file refusal is produced by the invocation that touches the file — the bootstrap step that appends the entry — and the layer that carried the reason renders nothing.
content.rationale: Only the envelope refuses and failures below it stay values carrying their evidence (S4-own, ouzvzypl; S3-err, uzzxlpsl), so where an exclude failure becomes the invocation's refusal is its own commitment: the unreadable-read and failed-append decisions (llkvmtou, zwurwxwq) say such a file refuses but not where the refusal is produced. The invocation that touched the file produces it; the layer that carried the reason renders nothing.
